items.label: Literary
items.text: Dialogue should be Literary: Standard novel dialogue. Contractions and fragments are natural; interruptions occur, but speech stays clean and purposeful. No filler words, no stumbling.

items.label: Casual
items.text: Dialogue should be Colloquial: Speech loosens. Slang, regional phrasing, sentence fragments, characters talking over each other and trailing off. Reads like a real conversation

items.label: Verbatim
items.text: Dialogue should be Verbatim: Full disfluency. Filler words ("Um.","like.", "okay." etc.), false starts, self-corrections, repetitions, and trailing sentences. Disfluency scales with emotional state. Calm speech is close to casual and colloquial, and stress, drunkenness, exhaustion, or grief break it apart

items.label: Halting
items.text: halting speech: people restart sentences, trail off and talk over each other
